description: This Java source file defines the `DefinitionManager` class, which serves as a GUI component for managing ECU definition files in the RomRaider application. It provides functionalities such as adding, removing, reordering, and saving ECU definition files, with a user interface built using Swing, and interacts with settings management and launcher components.

classes.name: DefinitionManager
classes.description: A GUI window for managing and prioritizing ECU definition files used within RomRaider. It supports adding, removing, reordering, applying, and cancelling changes to the list of definition files, with saved settings persisted via SettingsManager.

methods.name: initComponents
methods.description: Initializes and configures the Swing components and layout for the DefinitionManager GUI.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles user actions such as button clicks for cancel, save, apply, move up/down, add, remove, and undo.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Persists the current list of definition files into the settings storage.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Opens a file chooser dialog to add a new ECU definition file to the list.

methods.name: moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the selected definition file up or down in the list.

methods.name: removeSelection
methods.description: Removes the selected definition file from the list.

methods.name: updateListModel
methods.description: Refreshes the list display with the current file names.
